About Us
Great Food

Great Food for the whole family.  Choose from a thin crust pizza with Whole Milk Buffalo Mozzarella, Traditional and Boneless Wings, a fresh Greek Salad, or an appetizer of our must have Garlic Cheese Toast.

Fresh Ingredients

We use the Best Mozzarella cheese available on the market for our Pizza, our Salads and Vegetables are cut fresh. Even our Greek Sauce is made in house from scratch.

Order TakeOut or Delivery

We offer two different partner Delivery companies to choose from.  Choose either:  DoorDash or UberEats.  You must order delivery Online through their sites (Link Above).  If you prefer to pick up your order, then you may choose our Online Ordering for In-Store Pick Up or call and order To GO.
